quality_check.description: A single tall 9:16 hand-layered paper-cut scene shows a deep receding corridor of repeated small bed silhouettes progressing through nested slate-blue night layers. A large dark simplified paper heart anchors the lower-left foreground and an overloaded cluster of blue-gray cells with warm honey interiors anchors the lower-right. The scene is enclosed by the recurring thick layered cream-paper frame with fibrous irregular edges and an inset orchard-green, slate-blue, amber, and cream illustrated window. The full usable height remains illustrated with no caption reserve, text, host, or UI.
violations: The foreground heart communicates heaviness through dark slate layering but its stressed state is somewhat subtle; a clearer paper-cut stress cue such as restrained tension marks or deformation would strengthen the requested cardiovascular-risk endpoint.
Several of the smallest receding bed silhouettes become partially abstract and less immediately legible as beds at extreme depth.
The metabolic-cell cluster is visually overloaded and contains warm honey centers, but some outer forms can also read as a generic clustered organic mass rather than unmistakably cellular shapes.
The darkest slate corridor layers dominate much of the upper-middle image, slightly reducing the orchard-green and amber presence compared with the established reference balance.
